description: `prose delete` (no `cli`) exits 2 with `cli program delete --help`, and the Action names `cli job delete`; nothing is forwarded or billed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: `delete` is not a command; did you mean `prose cli program delete --help`? Runs are never deleted; a saved program is deleted with `cli program delete SLUG` and a job with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: A job is deleted with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Use `cli program delete SLUG`; `prose cli program delete --help` shows its arguments.
